title: Budget terse show after its safe projection
outcome: Terse show retains the newest bounded history and navigable relations that fit its own response even when the host-rich focus view contains large omitted fields.
acceptance: An oversized rich-focus fixture proves terse show is fitted after projection and does not prematurely omit retained fields.

completion.summary: Satisfied by earlier implementation; verified in current triage against the rich-focus regressions and projection-before-fitting code. Closing verified existing work, not claiming authorship of earlier code or a new test run.
